summary: UseEfCoreStore re-registers IDbContextFactory<DabblerSecurityDbContext> with a SQL Server options lambda, which is redundant against the scoped factory AddDabblerSecurity already registered on line 65.
resolution: Pre-existing from the Session 2 DbContextFactory migration (Session 2 of this set). The UseEfCoreStore registration uses a different options lambda (ConnectionString from DabblerSecurityOptions, vs the lambda captured in AddDabblerSecurity) and is only reached when an app calls UseEfCoreStore() after AddDabblerSecurity() — last-wins DI semantics make this a deliberate override, not an accidental duplicate. Session 4 did not touch this method. Not a Session 4 regression.

summary: Test method named Dashboard_CrossOrgUserAdmin_SeesFourTabs but asserts three tabs (TabCount == 3).
resolution: Renamed to Dashboard_CrossOrgUserAdmin_SeesThreeTabs to match the assertion. Pre-existing naming drift that the Session 3 per-role tab work made more visible; corrected inline.
